record.paper_title: Open Problems in K-Stability of Fano Varieties
record.original_question: For integers n and d with 3 <= d <= n + 1, describe the K-moduli space H^K_{n,d} that parametrizes degree-d n-dimensional hypersurfaces in the range considered in the paper.

evidence.quote:
Problem 7. Describe the K-moduli space HK
n,d (3 ≤ d ≤ n + 1).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ and $d$ be integers with $3 \leq d \leq n+1$. A smooth hypersurface $X \subset \mathbb{P}^{n+1}_{\mathbb{C}}$ of degree $d$ is a Fano manifold (since $-K_X = (n+2-d)H|_X$ is ample under the assumption $d \leq n+1$). 

Recall that a $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano variety is K-semistable (resp. K-polystable) if its generalized Futaki invariant is non-negative (resp. non-negative, with equality only for product test configurations) for every normal test configuration. By the work on the construction of K-moduli (Jiang, Blum–Xu, Liu–Xu–Zhuang, Xu–Zhuang and others), there exists a projective good moduli space
$$ H^K_{n,d} $$
parametrizing K-polystable $\mathbb{Q}$-Fano varieties that arise as K-semistable degenerations of smooth degree-$d$ hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{P}^{n+1}$, with an open substack parametrizing the smooth hypersurfaces themselves.

Problem. For each pair $(n,d)$ with $3 \leq d \leq n+1$, give an explicit description of the K-moduli space $H^K_{n,d}$: identify all K-polystable degenerations on its boundary, describe its relation (if any) to the GIT moduli space of degree-$d$ hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{P}^{n+1}$, and determine its global geometry (e.g. as a projective variety, possibly with a wall-crossing or VGIT interpretation).
artifact.status_search_result: Explicit descriptions of K-moduli spaces of Fano hypersurfaces are known in several specific low-dimensional or low-degree cases (e.g. cubic surfaces, cubic threefolds by Liu–Xu, cubic fourfolds by Liu, quartic threefolds, quartic and quintic del Pezzo cases) and progress continues via the moduli-continuity method and wall-crossing/VGIT techniques. However, a uniform description for the full range $3 \leq d \leq n+1$ remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: K-stability of Fano varieties - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: K-moduli spaces have been constructed as projective good moduli spaces parametrizing K-polystable Fano varieties; explicit descriptions are known in special cases.
status_evidence.claim: General K-moduli spaces exist but explicit descriptions exist only in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Moduli of linear slices of high degree smooth hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work studies moduli of hypersurface-related Fano varieties; full description for arbitrary (n,d) is not available.
status_evidence.claim: The general explicit description for all (n,d) in the indicated range is not yet established.
